During our simulation, we follow the prototypical discrete-time version proposed by Ernoult et al. (2019) to simulate the neural states dynamics.

The test error with continual updates is 0.2% to 0.3% higher than with phase-based updates, as also observed by Ernoult et al. (2020). A likely explanation is that the learning rate must be kept small during the nudged phase to preserve the accuracy of the gradient estimate, which slows convergence and can limit the final performance.
